title: Associate Consultant – Business Insights
jobDescription:
BASIC INFORMATION: Job Location: Hyderabad Experience: 2–3 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Mode of Work: Work From Office Compensation: As per industry standards Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days COMPANY DESCRIPTION: Strategic Research Insights, Inc. is a marketing consulting firm serving clients in the US and global pharmaceutical sector headquartered in Princeton, NJ, USA. Our goal is to improve the business performance of clients who seek our services and grow alongside them. Earlier in 2021, we established a new office in Hyderabad, India and are now looking to expand this team further. JOB DESCRIPTION: The role of a business insights Associate Consultant is to assist our clients in building the right strategy to improve brand equity and market share via several dimensions. Candidates will learn and develop several skills to improve their evidence-based thinking and understand how twenty first century global corporations are leveraging data from customers to improve business performance. The role involves a learning agenda as well as instant application of concepts learned. Candidates applying for this position will have an excellent opportunity to use their quantitative and problem-solving skills to identify key steps to improve the business performance of our clients’ products. The position is ideal for those who have a flair for identifying trends and patterns in a vast array of data and crystallize such information into actionable steps. Associate Consultant – Business Insights will:
- Learn how to interpret data and draw conclusions in a business context from team leaders who have advanced degrees in business administration.
- Guide and mentor junior team members.
- Understand how data on customer perceptions regarding our clients’ products are used to improve market performance.
- Develop an appreciation of key marketing concepts such as strategic segmentation and how to implement those solutions in different client projects.
- Gather insights on the effectiveness of current messaging and develop an optimal messaging strategy.
- Contribute to new product development efforts by identifying the optimal product profile given key technical and regulatory constraints.
- Learn and use our innovative approaches to predict new product demand and assess impact on the market due to self, and competitive product introductions.
- Identify key drivers and barriers for new product adoption.
- Isolate triggers to convert non-users to users and develop tactical action items for increased adoption.
- Assess the effectiveness of current marketing campaigns and estimate the return on investments of ongoing direct-to-consumer TV and magazine advertisements.
- Develop a roadmap of patient journey from diagnosis to treatment to adherence to pharmacologic therapy from unprecedented volume of data generated by the health care industry.
- Understand price elasticity of demand among patients for different therapeutic options and develop a pricing strategy for our client company products.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously coordinating with internal and external vendors, establishing clear communication amongst stakeholders
- Fast learner, with an ability to grasp various analytical concepts / techniques and use them to generate actionable business insights for the clients. CANDIDATE PROFILE:
- An undergrad or master’s degree in quantitative/Analytical field (Such as Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Economics, etc.) from a reputed institution
- 2-3 years of relevant work experience
- Strong written and oral communication skills in English
- Passion for problem solving through data analysis and consulting.
- Position is highly suitable for those who have a flair for consulting and those who have an interest in pursuing business education in the future.
- Must possess leadership and organizational development skills with the flair for working in a team environment as the role involves interacting with team members in different departments.
- Good work ethics and attention to detail
- Ability to consolidate, summarize and communicate strategic thinking.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Power Point to communicate results.
- Understanding of pharma and biotech industry is an added advantage.
- Experience of people management (at least 1-2 people) is an added advantage. SELECTION PROCESS:
1. HR interview
2. Technical interview
3. Interview with the Director

title: Associate Manager – Data Science
jobDescription:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION: Strategic Research Insights LLP. is a boutique healthcare consulting firm, specializing in global market research and analytics. SRI is a young, dynamic company with a rapid growth rate. We have our headquarters situated at Princeton, New Jersey, USA. We have our four business units situated at Florida in the USA and Chennai, Hyderabad, Tirunelveli in India.
- Focus on delivering action-oriented insights through custom quantitative market research
- Concentration in pharma / biotech / healthcare industry
- Work with experienced professionals with advanced degrees in marketing / market research / operations research / statistics
- Conduct research in over 50 countries with physicians, patients, payers, and more POSITION SUMMARY: Candidates would support our internal teams and clients in driving strategic decisions, applying advanced statistical & predictive analytics and machine learning concepts to solve business problems in pharmaceutical domain Required Skills and

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Full time Degree in Computer Science or Computer Applications from reputed institutions, B.E./B.Tech., MBA specialized in Marketing, Operations Research, Data Science and/or Business Analytics
- Associate manager: 5+ years Needed
- Practical modeling experience specifically around quantitative and analytical skills and/or Natural Language Processing (NLP) using LLMs is required
- Knowledge of solution design, planning, and execution
- People management skills and experience, and familiarity with the pharmaceutical industry are preferred.
- Hands on experience in one or more of the skillsets below is desirable:
- Programming Language: Base SAS, Advanced SAS
- Tools: Snowflake, Dataiku, Azure ML Studio, Power BI etc.
- Visualization Tool: Power BI, Tableau, MS Excel, think-cell, , Qlik Sense
- Automation Tool: VBA Macro, Python scripts Essential Duties and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Application of advanced statistical & predictive analytics and machine learning models to solve business problems
- Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts to non-experts
- Guide the team in using state-of-the-art data science technologies to improve efficiency and productivity
- Communicate and collaborate with other team members/team lead to prepare analysis plans on different engagements
- Plan and analyze different pharma data sets and create management consulting reports
- Hands on experience in developing production grade ML models
- Proficiency in Python to work with data files to create different kinds of charts, roll-up summaries, different aggregations and perform various analyses
- Analyze data for patterns or trends to determine factors that influence outcomes
- Working experience in Hive and HUE to store data and provide retrieval capabilities as needed, using queries and/or stored procedures is desirable
- Convert insights to visual graphics like charts, graphs, and tables
- Maintain extremely high standards of quality in all deliverables
- Perform both as an Individual Contributor and as a team coordinator
- Plan and allocate work to team members, monitor and track to closure
- Review and perform quality control of the team member’s deliverables
- Develop, update, and implement standard operating procedures for data analysis to maintain quality What we offer
- Competitive compensation packages that reward high performance
- Fast track career with supportive culture that facilitates 360 degrees learning
- Collaborative team-based environment with mentorship from the industry leaders
- Comprehensive Health Insurance package Note: Depending on the specific role, some of the requirements may not apply
